name: pug-scheduling
description: Skills for Pug.Scheduling, the tenant-aware, database-backed job scheduler: its model, lifecycle and guarantees (at-least-once, misfire, retry, run-now), hosting the scheduler and execution coordinator, running workers in-process or remotely, writing job handlers, and managing schedules through IScheduler and SchedulerClient. Versioned with the Pug.Scheduling packages.
